actions.action: Give the four # noqa: E402 suppressions in skills/assess/scripts/assess_report.py a recorded reason (inline, or a per-file ignore for the script entry points)
actions.done_when: cd skills/assess && uv run --locked ruff check . passes and every E402 suppression in the file carries a reason
actions.scope_fence: Suppression comments or ruff config only; no import reordering and no other edits to assess_report.py

actions.action: Give the 32 # noqa: E402 suppressions in skills/fleet/scripts/fleet.py a recorded reason, or replace them with one per-file ignore
actions.done_when: uv run --locked ruff check ../fleet/scripts (from skills/assess) reports no E402 and each suppression carries a reason or is covered by a per-file ignore
actions.scope_fence: Suppression comments or ruff config only; bringing skills/fleet/scripts under the CI lint job is a separate change

actions.action: Split skills/ghreport/scripts/ghreport.sh along its seams into sourced helper files (GitHub queries, GitLab queries, the settings section, rendering)
actions.first_step: rg -n "^[a-z_]+\(\)" skills/ghreport/scripts/ghreport.sh and group the 26 functions by seam
actions.done_when: tests/test_ghreport.py, tests/test_ghreport_gitlab.py and tests/test_gitbash.py pass unchanged, the Windows Git Bash job is green, and no resulting file is over 800 lines
actions.scope_fence: Move functions only, no behaviour change; the standalone ZIP build must still ship every sourced file
